purpose: Read-only exact OSE Nikkei 225 Micro Futures market-data bridge using the user's existing Yuanta SPARK API entitlement when available.

instrument.exact_contract_requirement: Use the exact Yuanta StockCode for the active individual contract month. Never substitute a continuous symbol.
instrument.stock_code_discovery: Read the StockCode from Yuanta SPARK API FunctionList.xls / stock-name mapping bundled with the installed API. Do not guess month-code syntax.

validation_gates: Login succeeds with user's own Yuanta futures account.
Exact JNU individual-month StockCode is resolved from Yuanta-provided mapping.
SubscribeStockTick returns MarketType=OSE and the exact requested StockCode.
SubscribeFiveTickA returns nonzero bid/ask depth for that exact contract.
Provider timestamps/sequence are captured and observed age is suitable for JNU Research freshness rules.
No trade/order API call is present in the bridge.

jpX_research_result.free_trial: OSE may offer one-month real-time market-data trial for internal evaluation; historical tick sample/trial may be available subject to conditions.
